notes:
v1.2.1 — critical fixes on top of v1.2.0.

• Cross-worker dedup for cloud bots — the APEX server runs uvicorn with 2 workers, and each worker had its own bot registry. Clicking ▶ from a different worker than the one that spawned the original bot would spawn a duplicate. Fixed by writing/reading PID files at /opt/apex_users/user_<id>/pids/<side>.pid so any worker can see what's already running.
• Cloud resume on app startup now works for LONG / SHORT too — previously it gated on the local 'Run on Oracle' toggle, which the desktop sometimes lost between sessions even though the cloud bot kept running. Resume now always asks Oracle for live status.
• Stale brackets no longer shown on the daybot chart. After you liquidated a position manually, the bracket gauge used to keep displaying it at '+0.0%' (current price falling back to entry because no live position existed). Now filtered out by symbol presence in the Alpaca positions list.
• Killed 6 duplicate bot processes that v1.2.0 had spawned on Oracle.
